verses.text: They took their journey from Elim, and all the congregation of the children of Israel came to the wilderness of Sin, which is between Elim and Sinai, on the fifteenth day of the second month after their departing out of the țară of Egipt.
The whole congregation of the children of Israel murmured against Moise and against Aaron in the wilderness; (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)

and the children of Israel i-a zis lui them, We wish that we had died by the DOMNUL’s mână in the țară of Egipt, when we sat by the meat pots, when we ate our fill of bread, for you have brought us out into this wilderness to kill this whole assembly with hunger.

Then the DOMNUL i-a zis lui Moise, Behold, I will rain bread from the sky for you, and the people shall să plece out and gather a day’s portion every day, that I may test them, whether they will walk in my law or not.
It shall come to pass on the sixth day, that they shall prepare that which they bring in, and it shall be twice as much as they gather daily. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
Moise and Aaron i-a zis lui all the children of Israel, At evening, you shall know that the DOMNUL has brought you out from the țară of Egipt.
In the morning, you shall see the DOMNUL’s glory; because he hears your murmurings against the DOMNUL. Who are we, that you murmur against us? (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)

Moise a zis, Now the DOMNUL will give you meat to eat in the evening, and in the morning bread to satisfy you, because the DOMNUL hears your murmurings which you murmur against him. And who are we? Your murmurings are not against us, but against the DOMNUL. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
Moise i-a zis lui Aaron, Tell all the congregation of the children of Israel, ‘Come close to the DOMNUL, for he has heard your murmurings.’  (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)

As Aaron a vorbit lui the whole congregation of the children of Israel, they looked toward the wilderness, and behold, the DOMNUL’s glory appeared in the cloud. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
The DOMNUL a vorbit lui Moise, saying, (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)

I have heard the murmurings of the children of Israel. Speak to them, saying, ‘At evening you shall eat meat, and in the morning you shall be filled with bread. Then you will know that Eu sunt the DOMNUL your Dumnezeu.’  (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
In the evening, quail came up and covered the camp; and in the morning the dew lay around the camp. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
When the dew that lay had să plecene, behold, on the surface of the wilderness was a small round thing, small as the frost on the ground.

When the children of Israel saw it, they i-a zis lui one another, What is it? For they didn’t know what it was. Moise i-a zis lui them, It is the bread which the DOMNUL has given you to eat. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)

This is the thing which the DOMNUL has commanded: ‘Gather of it everyone according to his eating; an omer a head, according to the number of your persons, you shall take it, every man for those who are in his tent.’  (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
The children of Israel did so, and some gathered more, some less. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)

When they measured it with an omer, he who gathered much had nothing over, and he who gathered little had no lack. They each gathered according to his eating. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
Moise i-a zis lui them, Let no one leave of it until the morning. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)

Notwithstanding they didn’t listen to Moise, but some of them left of it until the morning, so it bred worms and became foul; and Moise was angry with them. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
They gathered it morning by morning, everyone according to his eating. When the sun grew hot, it melted. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
On the sixth day, they gathered twice as much bread, two omers for each one; and all the rulers of the congregation came and told Moise. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)

He i-a zis lui them, This is that which the DOMNUL has spoken, ‘Tomorrow is a solemn rest, a holy Sabbath to the DOMNUL. Bake that which you want to bake, and boil that which you want to boil; and all that remains over lay up for yourselves to be kept until the morning.’  (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
They laid it up until the morning, as Moise ordered, and it didn’t become foul, and there were no worms in it. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
Moise a zis, Eat that today, for today is a Sabbath to the DOMNUL. Today you shall not find it in the field. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
Six days you shall gather it, but on the seventh day is the Sabbath. In it there shall be none. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
On the seventh day, some of the people went out to gather, and they found none. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
The DOMNUL i-a zis lui Moise, How long do you refuse to keep my commandments and my laws? (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)

Behold, because the DOMNUL has given you the Sabbath, therefore he gives you on the sixth day the bread of two days. Everyone stay in his place. Let no one să plece out of his place on the seventh day.
So the people rested on the seventh day. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
The house of Israel called its name Manna, and it was like coriander seed, white; and its taste was like wafers with honey. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)

Moise a zis, This is the thing which the DOMNUL has commanded, ‘Let an omer-full of it be kept throughout your generations, that they may see the bread with which I fed you in the wilderness, when I brought you out of the țară of Egipt.’
Moise i-a zis lui Aaron, Take a pot, and put an omer-full of manna in it, and lay it up before the DOMNUL, to be kept throughout your generations. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
As the DOMNUL commanded Moise, so Aaron laid it up before the Testimony, to be kept. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
The children of Israel ate the manna forty years, until they came to an inhabited țară. They ate the manna until they came to the borders of the țară of Canaan.
Now an omer is one tenth of an ephah. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
